purpose: Test whether a depth-ramped interpolation coefficient improves train-split calibration over the registered constant coefficient, before any test split is read. This is a calibration experiment, not a new claim instrument.

retrospective.reason: This file was first added by commit b23c395ce5f01bc6e60d0d91fde4b35d1bed41eb at 2026-11-21T03:12:54Z, while the first non-smoke receipt that names it, results/stage2/s68-ramp/build.json, has stamp 20261121T031224Z and created_utc 2026-11-21T03:12:24Z: the receipt existed 30 s before the file entered the repository. The label is therefore retrospective. What preceded the commit is the depth-ramp builder receipt (kind depth-ramp-build), not a calibration or test score: the first calibration score has stamp 20261121T085502Z and the one-shot test receipt has stamp 20261121T180406Z, both later than the commit. The file's substantive content is unchanged; only this label, the evidence block and the disposition were appended.

disposition.adopted_if: any of the three champion-comparison indicators in the verdict receipt is true
disposition.reason: the verdict records beats_soup_champion false on GSM8K, MATH-500 and full MATH; the constant-alpha soup remains the champion (docs/S68-RESULT.md section 3.2), so the ramp changed no selection and no adoption outside its own calibration gate

formula.l_index: the numeric suffix of `layers.<l>.` in the arm_state key, 0-based
formula.state: theta_ramp(key in layer l) = theta_0(key) + alpha(l) * delta_bar(key), where delta_bar = mean over the three S66 seed deltas and theta_0 is the post-trained 0.8B endpoint
formula.non_layer_parameters: norm.weight (the final norm) has no layer index and is mixed at alpha_deep; the receipt lists every such key
formula.arithmetic: float32 accumulation, rounded back to the base tensor dtype (bf16)
formula.tied_embedding: the tied embedding/output projection is frozen and inherited from the post-trained snapshot, exactly as in S67

grid.identity: every (alpha_shallow, alpha_deep) pair is built and scored, including alpha_shallow == alpha_deep, which is a constant check

base.equivalence_check: the soup alpha=0 checkpoint must be tensor-for-tensor equal to results/stage2/s60-interpolation/interp-0.000-arm.pt before its row is reused

gsm8k_cal.split: gsm8k train, registered S66 calibration split

math_cal.split: Hendrycks MATH train, registered S66 calibration split

mmlu_cal.split: the registered 2,000-item MMLU selection partition, 5-shot lm-evaluation-harness
mmlu_cal.role: retention filter, never an accuracy objective

instrument.protocol: greedy, non-thinking, zero-shot, S54 user template, max_new_tokens 2048 for the two generation tasks; MMLU via scripts/s43_score_total_cap.py with --total-cap-map mmlu=2000

selection_rule.admissible_set: the nine depth-ramped arms (the constant control is not a selection candidate)
selection_rule.objective: mean gain over the alpha = 0 row on GSM8K-cal and MATH-cal
selection_rule.retention: an arm whose calibration MMLU is more than 1.0 point below the alpha = 0 row is ineligible
selection_rule.tie_break: smaller mean coefficient (alpha_shallow + alpha_deep) / 2, then smaller alpha_deep, then lexicographic arm tag
selection_rule.adoption_test: the selected ramp arm is adopted only if its calibration mean over GSM8K-cal and MATH-cal is strictly greater than the constant alpha = 0.375 control's mean on the same splits; otherwise the result is recorded as negative and the constant-alpha soup is retained
selection_rule.cost_discipline: MMLU-cal may be run after the two generation splits; an arm that cannot beat the control on the mean is ineligible before MMLU can change anything

one_shot_test_scoring.condition: only if the selected ramp arm is adopted by the calibration rule above
instruments: full MATH, 5,000 problems, the pre-registered S67 resolution instrument, scored once
one_shot_test_scoring.comparison: the post-trained Qwen3.5-0.8B baseline under the same instruments and protocol, paired at problem/item level, 4,000 resamples, seed 53
one_shot_test_scoring.no_enlargement: the full-MATH instrument is not re-scored or enlarged on the basis of a ramp result; it is a one-shot test that either resolves or does not
one_shot_test_scoring.no_frontier_claim: no external system is compared; a ramp result is a capability statement for this intervention only
